about: Price suggestions per INDUCKS series for Paste prices (value for condition Z1). Edited by Claude; see CLAUDE.md.

it/TL.note: Topolino libretto. From Bolaffi 2024 auction (No. 1 6000 € top copy), articles (fumettirari), eBay/Catawiki 2025–26.

it/TG.note: Topolino giornale: auctions (No. 1 16,000 €), Little Nemo, Disneyana.it, eBay. Old issues are the least certain.

it/TLDLE.note: Estimate from cover prices (no sales found).

it/SAP.note: eBay/Wallapop asking prices for 1985 issues (3–4.90 €); No. 1 is an estimate.

it/PM.note: Estimate; one near-new issue sold for 1.50 €.

it/DDCO.note: Estimate from cover prices (no sales found).

it/PBST.note: Estimate from cover prices (no sales found).

it/DSBP.note: Estimate from cover prices; 16V (Limited Deluxe) about 80 € on its own.

it/LETP.note: Estimate from cover prices 21–27 € (no sales found).

it/CALE.note: Used copy at Libraccio at about 55 % of cover price.

de/LTB.note: Lustiges Taschenbuch, FIRST printing (1. Auflage), top condition. Later printings are worth far less (LTB 1 reprint about 5–15 €). Rough guide from eBay.de sales 2025–26 (LTB 24 1st printing 42–85 €, lots of LTB 101–150 at about 4 € each) and Comicguide (LTB 1 1st printing up to about 1000 €).

de/MM.note: Micky Maus Magazin, originals (not the reprints), top condition. Rough guide: 1951/1 eBay.de 6500 € (2025), Eppli auction start 5500 € (1951/1) and 750 € (1951/2); reprints of 1951/1 only 10–50 €. Later years from eBay.de prices.

se/KA.note: Kalle Anka & C:o, originals (not the facsimiles from 1983 and 1998), very fine condition. Rough guide: 1948/1 sold on Tradera for 150 600 kr (2026, record), earlier 105 600 kr; Seriekatalogen VF about 5000 kr for 1949 issues. Ordinary issues from 1970 on: Tradera 20–40 kr.

se/KAP.note: Kalle Ankas Pocket, very fine condition. Rough guide: Seriekatalogen VF 750 kr for nr 1 (1968); Tradera 2025: about 29 kr each for nr 65–340.

id:x-asterix-german.note: Asterix (Ehapa), per printing. 1. Auflage 1–13 (softcover and hardcover): Comicguide Z1 via comedix.de (as of 2017). Everything else: estimates from eBay/Kleinanzeigen listings 2025–26 (later printings are rarely worth more than a few euros).
